description: Execute a Python script inside Blender with the full bpy API available. Optionally open a 3D file first (any format Blender imports) and export the edited scene afterwards, chosen by the output extension. Anything printed is returned as stdout, and assigning a JSON-serializable value to a variable named `result` returns it as structured data. Use this for scene edits the other tools do not cover: decimating meshes, joining or renaming objects, editing armatures, baking animation, cleaning materials. The script runs with the permissions of this server and can read and write the local filesystem.

apply_modifiers.description: Apply modifiers when exporting. Default true.

code.description: Python source to execute. `bpy`, `math`, and `Vector` are already imported.

input.description: 3D file to open before running the script. Omit to start from an empty scene.

output.description: Export the scene here after the script runs; the extension selects the format. Omit to discard it.

name: blender_run_python
title: Run a Python script inside Blender
